description: A tensor accumulator kept computation graphs alive across training updates.

notes: The retain_graph=True bug is explicitly documented in the source code comments. Removing it preserves all training mathematics (loss, gradients, optimizer steps, weight decay, scheduler) and requires no policy permission.

Peak memory after fix will be the forward/backward working set for a single step (batch=8, seq=1024, width=1024, 6 layers with 4x FFN expansion). Estimated forward peak ~3-5 GB, well within GPU capacity.
Optimizer state (0 GB at current peak) and gradients (0 GB) are not the bottleneck; the 24.5 GB activations peak is entirely due to graph retention across steps.
No batch size or gradient accumulation changes needed; the bug fix alone addresses the OOM.

root_causes.title: Unnecessary retain_graph=True retains full autograd graph across training steps

limitations: Numerical comparison covers five backward-loss scalars against an offloaded reference, not all 20 candidate updates.
